TEXT:
Under the blazing sun, my chest was swelling with 
expectations, waiting for Ayase to finish changing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: The time has finally come!

I'm probably wearing a pretty unpleasant 
expression right now. I'm aware of that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Still, she's pretty late.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Ah, it's hot.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Hey, she's still not done yet?

Sure, it supposedly takes girls a lot of time to 
change, but now I'm starting to get worried.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Hm? What's all the commotion about?

I wasn't paying attention, but there's a huge crowd 
at that side of the beach.

It doesn't seem like Ayase's coming any time soon, 
so I guess I'll take a look?

Urged on by my curiosity, I pushed through the 
crowd until...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...What the heck are you up to?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: I-It's about time you noticed! Help me out here!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Oh, I'm glad to see you're enjoying soaking in the 
sun. See ya later!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Wait! You're just gonna leave me here?! Help me 
out! We're friends, right?

Hey, wait. Who made me your friend? Don't make 
these people think I'm with you on this!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Hurry up already! Before that person gets back!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...That person?

Who's "that person" anyway? I don't think I know 
anyone who's cruel enough to jus--

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: O-Onii-san? What are you doing here...
Oh, wait. I know one. A particularly cute one at that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Ayase. What's up with this chaotic situation...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: It seems like we were followed...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Uh huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: She came in order to spy on us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: All the way to Atami?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: All the way to Atami...
All that talent, wasted on this, huh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Enough already, just help me out!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, this is totally your own fault.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Y-You're abandoning me?! You gotta be kidding...

Yup, she's at fault, but this is just too pitiful. I'm 
sure this idiot has reflected on her actions, I'll try 
the gentle approach.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey, Ayase...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Would you mind if I helped her out?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I would mind, Onii-san.
Sorry, Kanako. I'm in no position to help you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
W-Wait! You could at least deal with the others in 
the same way though?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
If you want me to spill the beans, you know what 
to do, don't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Onii-san?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Come on, she looks like she's regretting it, right? 
Just let it slide for me, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...O-Only this time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: I-I'm saved~

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: So who else is involved?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: ...Look over there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Ki-Kirino?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Crap, they found out?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-She's fleeing!
What the heck is she up to?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Damn it!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ah, Onii-sa--

I chased after Kirino's escaping figure, she didn't 
even turn to look back.

But naturally, I couldn't catch up to her. Her figure 
quickly got smaller and smaller...

Of course things turned out this way. She's on the 
track team.
As I got back, Ayase was standing there alone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Huh? Where'd Kanako disappear to?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...She escaped.

Somehow, Kanako managed to escape her fate this 
time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see.

I felt a bit sorry for Ayase, but I breathed a sigh of 
relief. Seeing that, Ayase started pouting.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: You're so mean, Onii-san...
